# netbird_agent_network_guardrail (Data Source)

Read an Agent Network guardrail by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbird_agent_network_guardrail" "strict" {
  name = "Strict — Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Guardrail ID
- `name` (String) Display name for the guardrail

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description
- `model_allowlist` (Attributes) Model allowlist check (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_allowlist))
- `prompt_capture` (Attributes) Prompt capture settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prompt_capture))

### Nested Schema for `model_allowlist`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `models` (List of String)
